LUXEMBOURG — The European Parliament has “paranoia” when it comes to the far-right, Jordan Bardella’s lawyer claimed as his client fights to keep his right-hand man on the EU payroll.

Bardella took the Parliament to the EU’s General Court over its decision to stop François Paradol from working as a part-time MEP assistant, although the president of France’s far-right National Rally was not present in court on Wednesday.

Paradol, Bardella’s chief of staff, used to work as his part-time local MEP assistant in France. But in 2024, the Parliament turned down his reappointment in the wake of a case involving Bardella’s mentor, Marine Le Pen. She was found guilty of embezzling cash meant for MEPs from 2004 to 2016, and using the money to pay for national party staff.
